checks.text: The page heading is "Floor Plan Editor".
Clicking the button labeled "Add layer" adds a new item to the layer list with the text "Layer 1".
With "Layer 1" selected, clicking the button labeled "Delete layer" removes "Layer 1" from the layer list and shows the text "No layers".
Clicking the tab labeled "Layers" shows the layer list; clicking the tab labeled "Canvas" shows the drawing surface and hides the layer list.
Clicking the button labeled "Export PNG" triggers a download of a file named "floor-plan.png".
Selecting the option "Grid" in the select labeled "Background" changes the canvas background to a grid pattern.
Typing "Living Room" in the field labeled "Room name" and clicking the button labeled "Add room" adds a list item containing "Living Room" to the room list.
Clicking the button labeled "Delete Living Room" removes the "Living Room" item from the room list.
Reload keeps the layer named "Layer 1" and the room named "Living Room" visible in their respective lists.
